study_status: Post-US exploratory transfer of frozen allocation mapping to already inspected international Ridge forecast paths
forecast_algorithm: StandardScaler plus Ridge; inherited country/theme/model initial-training alpha selection frozen thereafter
state_rule: Initial-training growth/inflation medians; fixed thresholds, strict greater-than high; low/low Slowdown reference
risk_cutoff: Signal month, using original decimal theme returns on 36 complete natural months
turnover_convention: Half L1 difference between adjacent target weights; initial entry free; no drift adjustment
bootstrap_method: US API non-circular overlapping moving-block percentile-t; conditional on fixed forecasts and no model refitting
holm_family: Four international mean-return comparisons per HAC lag: UK and DE x Macro-HM and Macro+Regime-Macro; separate from US/forecast families
external_validity_limit: Different factor-theme constructions, predictors, forecast algorithms, currency conventions and sample windows; current-vintage and previously inspected inputs; not a clean independent across-market holdout
